sentiment.test_policy: Deduplicated official test partition; exact overlaps removed from train; validation grouped by IMDb movie ID. Not the untouched official 25000-row benchmark.
sentiment.model: TF-IDF 1-2 grams with logistic regression; C=2.0
sentiment.runtime_policy: Binary probability blended with contextual negation, neutral-cue and mixed-evidence rules
sentiment.runtime_validation: The 90.05% benchmark applies to the saved binary model, not the four-label runtime policy; validate the runtime policy on a separately annotated four-class set before making accuracy claims.

ALS.split: Per-user earliest 80% train, next 10% validation, last 10% test
ALS.serving_boundary: Only active on real catalog; demo IDs isolated.
